items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: he is aware, he knows what I'm into and so on

ctx.x: Some people have a broader aspect, they have more courage in some direction, or maybe they've had more time. But whatever it is, I've got a couple of scratched-out lines from

Bruce Lundfall on the back of Peter Levinson's note, which says, "I thought the album was great, it should be Woody's biggest album. I guess Woody's still younger than all of us. Signed, Bruce." So that doesn't mean he's interested in recording my band, but he is aware, he knows what I'm into and so on, and my whole -- most important thing right now is to make this album important enough so I can get with a label who's willing to --
